question: Which of the following countries hosted the 6th BIMSTEC Summit in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thailand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **6th BIMSTEC Summit** was hosted by **Thailand** in **April 2025**. BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation) is a regional organization comprising South Asian and Southeast Asian countries.
 
• **BIMSTEC** includes seven member countries: **Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, and Thailand**. These nations are focused on enhancing regional cooperation across various sectors.
 
• The summit was attended by heads of states and governments of the member countries to discuss critical regional issues and strategies for economic and social progress.
 
• The theme for the 6th BIMSTEC Summit was centered around **"Towards a Resilient and Prosperous Bay of Bengal Region."** Thailand, as the host country, emphasized enhancing collaboration in areas such as trade, connectivity, technology, and disaster management.
 
• Hosting this summit showcased Thailand's commitment to strengthening regional cooperation and its strategic role as a key player in the BIMSTEC framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About BIMSTEC:**

 
 
• The **Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC)** was established in **1997** with the aim of fostering regional integration and cooperation among member states.
 
• BIMSTEC focuses on 14 priority sectors, including **trade, technology, energy, transport, fisheries, agriculture, public health, poverty alleviation, counter-terrorism, and environment**.
 
• The BIMSTEC Secretariat is located in **Dhaka, Bangladesh**.
 
 
 
• **Thailand's Role in BIMSTEC:**
 
 
• Thailand plays a critical role in BIMSTEC due to its geographical position, connecting South Asia with Southeast Asia.
 
• The country has been actively involved in promoting **connectivity projects**, including the development of the **Trilateral Highway** between India, Myanmar, and Thailand.
 
• Thailand has also emphasized enhancing maritime cooperation and disaster management mechanisms within the BIMSTEC framework.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the BIMSTEC Summit:**
 
 
• BIMSTEC summits provide a platform for high-level discussions on regional issues, fostering collaboration among member countries to address common challenges.
 
• The summits aim to enhance economic growth, strengthen connectivity, and promote sustainable development in the Bay of Bengal region.
 
• The organization serves as a bridge between South Asia and Southeast Asia, boosting trade and cultural exchanges.
 
 
 
• **Key Outcomes of Previous Summits:**
 
 
• The 5th BIMSTEC Summit, held in **Colombo, Sri Lanka**, focused on the adoption of the **BIMSTEC Charter** and agreements on enhancing connectivity and counter-terrorism cooperation.
 
• Member states have consistently worked towards implementing the **Master Plan for Transport Connectivity (2018-2030)** to improve regional connectivity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Thailand's Strategic Importance:**

 
 
• Thailand is strategically located in Southeast Asia, serving as a gateway between South Asia and ASEAN countries.
 
• The country has been a strong advocate for regional integration and has actively participated in BIMSTEC initiatives.
 
 
 
• **BIMSTEC and Regional Connectivity:**
 
 
• BIMSTEC has been working on enhancing connectivity through projects like the **India-Myanmar-Thailand Trilateral Highway** and the **Kaladan Multimodal Transit Transport Project**.
 
• These projects aim to improve trade links and transportation infrastructure across the region.
 
 
 
• **Future Prospects:**
 
 
• BIMSTEC aims to expand its cooperation in areas such as **blue economy, climate change adaptation,** and **people-to-people connectivity**.
 
• The organization seeks to strengthen ties with other regional and global entities to address emerging challenges and opportunities.
